S60.01.needs: A signed-in account that has AGI Work (the capability canUseAgiWork); the plan that grants it was not verified from the code.
S60.01.note: The "New task" button and the start sheet only appear when the account has canUseAgiWork.
steps: On the chat screen, tap the "Open menu" button.
Tap "AGI Work" in the menu.
Tap the "New task" button (bottom right). On an empty list, the "Hand off a task" card also has a "New task" button.
In the sheet, type what the task should do in "What should it accomplish?", then tap "Start task".
Look for a new task card in the AGI Work list that shows it is running, and compare with Expected.
S60.01.where: Open menu > AGI Work > New task

S60.02.needs: A signed-in account with at least one AGI Work task.
S60.02.note: The title is the chat's conversation title, or the fallback "AGI work task". The code has no control on the task screen to set or change it, and I did not find the conversation rename menu label, so changing the title is unconfirmed.
steps: On the chat screen, tap "Open menu", then tap "AGI Work".
Read the title in bold on each task card.
Compare the title with Expected.

S60.03.needs: A signed-in account that has AGI Work.
S60.03.note: The objective is shown back as the card preview and the title; the task detail view has no separate objective section.
steps: Open "AGI Work" from the menu, then tap "New task".
Type the objective in "What should it accomplish?" and tap "Start task".
Open the new task card and read the preview line under its title.
Compare the objective you typed with what the card or task shows.
S60.03.where: Open menu > AGI Work > New task

S60.04.needs: A signed-in account that has AGI Work.
S60.04.note: The deliverable is sent with the goal in startWork.ts; whether the run produces it is not confirmed by reading the code.
steps: Open "AGI Work" from the menu, then tap "New task".
Type a goal in "What should it accomplish?".
Type a deliverable in "Deliverable (optional)", for example "A one-page summary".
Tap "Start task", open the task, and compare the result with the deliverable you asked for.
S60.04.where: Open menu > AGI Work > New task

S60.13.needs: A signed-in account with AGI Work, on Cloud mode (the plan card is shown only when the app mode is cloud).
S60.13.note: The plan card is rendered from MessageBubble.tsx only when appMode is cloud; whether the agent always produces a plan first was not verified.
steps: On a chat, tap "Work" in the mode switch above the input (it is the Work tab).
Type a multi-step request and send it.
When the "Plan" card appears, read the steps. Tap a step to edit it, or use "Add a step" or "Remove this step".
Tap "Start work" to approve, or "Cancel" to reject. Compare with Expected.
S60.13.where: Chat screen > "Work" mode switch > send a message > "Plan" card

S60.14.needs: A signed-in account with an AGI Work task that has a plan.
S60.14.note: The heading "Plan · N" is built in CloudRunDetailSheet.tsx as a template string.
steps: Open "AGI Work" from the menu and tap a task card.
Scroll to the "Plan" section (its heading reads Plan with a step count).
Read each step line: number, description, then a status.
Compare each status with the work the run has done.
S60.14.where: Open menu > AGI Work > tap a task card > Plan section

S60.16.needs: A task that is still running.
S60.16.note: A step that was running when the run stopped shows "Stopped" instead of "In progress" (CloudRunDetailSheet.tsx).
steps: Start a task with "New task" in "AGI Work" or open one that is in the Running filter.
Tap its card and scroll to the "Plan" section while it runs.
Look for the one step whose status reads "In progress".
Wait a moment and check that the marked step moves on.
S60.16.where: Open menu > AGI Work > tap a running task card > Plan section

S60.18.needs: A task where the agent asked a question. The tester cannot force this.
S60.18.note: The form is shown from the run's pending input in CloudRunDetailSheet.tsx.
steps: Open "AGI Work" and tap the "Needs you" filter.
Tap a task that is waiting for a question.
Fill in the questions in the form that appears.
Tap "Send answer" (or "Continue" when there are no fields).
Check that the task moves back to Running and continues.
S60.18.where: Open menu > AGI Work > Needs you > tap the task > answer the form

S60.19.needs: A task that is waiting for approval. The tester cannot force this.
S60.19.note: The Approve and Deny buttons are shown in CloudRunDetailSheet.tsx only when the run has a pending approval.
steps: Open "AGI Work" and tap the "Needs you" filter.
Tap a task that is waiting for approval.
Read the pending action rows.
Tap "Approve" or "Deny", then check that the task continues or stops.
S60.19.where: Open menu > AGI Work > Needs you > tap the task > Approve or Deny

S60.20.needs: A task that is still running, queued or paused.
S60.20.note: The section is shown only while the run is steerable (CloudRunSteerSection.tsx), so it is not shown for finished tasks.
steps: Open "AGI Work" and tap a task that is Running.
Scroll to the "Message the agent" section at the bottom of the task.
Type in "Add instructions or change course" and tap "Send to the agent".
Check that your message appears and that the task keeps going without starting over.
S60.20.where: Open menu > AGI Work > tap a running task > Message the agent

S60.23.needs: A task that is still running.
S60.23.note: The server-side cancel is in apps/mobile/src/features/tasks/service.ts; the server result is not checked by reading the code.
steps: Open "AGI Work" and tap a task that is Running.
Scroll to the bottom and tap "Stop this task".
Read the dialog, then tap "Stop task" (or "Keep it running" to cancel).
Check that the task state changes to stopped, and compare with Expected.
S60.23.where: Open menu > AGI Work > tap a running task > Stop this task

S60.29.note: There is no separate summary heading; the summary is the latest output section.
steps: Open "AGI Work" and tap the "Finished" filter.
Tap a finished task card.
Scroll to the "Latest output" section.
Read the result text and compare it with Expected.
S60.29.where: Open menu > AGI Work > Finished > tap a finished task > Latest output

S60.30.needs: A task that produced a file. A file to produce one may need to be asked for in the task.
S60.30.note: The heading is a template string, "Files · N", in CloudRunFilesSection.tsx, so there is no fixed label to search for.
steps: Open "AGI Work" and tap a finished task that produced files.
Scroll to the Files section and read the file names and sizes.
Tap a file row to open or share it.
If it fails, read the alert text. Compare with Expected.
S60.30.where: Open menu > AGI Work > tap a task with files > Files section

S60.31.needs: A task that was stopped before it finished.
S60.31.note: The line is a template string in CloudRunDetailSheet.tsx: "Done N of M steps before it stopped.".
steps: Open "AGI Work" and tap a task that was stopped (for example, one you stopped with "Stop this task").
Scroll to the "Plan" section and read the step statuses.
Read the line that says how many steps were done before it stopped.
Compare with Expected.
S60.31.where: Open menu > AGI Work > Finished > tap a stopped task > plan list

S60.32.needs: A signed-in account with several past AGI Work tasks.
S60.32.note: The filter pill text comes from CLOUD_RUN_FILTERS in runPresentation.ts.
steps: On the chat screen, tap "Open menu", then tap "AGI Work".
Tap each filter pill: "All", "Needs you", "Running", "Finished".
Scroll down and tap "Load more" if it appears.
Tap any card to open its detail, and compare with Expected.

S60.34.needs: Two devices (or a phone and the web or desktop app) signed in to the same account.
S60.34.note: The task list is loaded from the server (service.ts); the cross-device result was not checked by reading the code.
steps: On device A, start a task from "AGI Work" > "New task".
On device B, signed in to the same account, open "Open menu" and tap "AGI Work".
Find the same task card, tap it, and read its state and steps.
Tap "Resume this task" or "Pause this task" on device B, then check device A shows the change.
S60.34.where: Open menu > AGI Work > tap the task > Resume this task (on the second device)
